svg.title: From main.bicep to resources
svg.desc: The pipeline builds main.bicep and its module vnet.bicep into main.json with a pinned Bicep, and Terraform deploys it as bicep-main in Incremental mode with parameters from the pipeline. The template makes the …bicep storage account and nsg-bicep; its nested deployment vnet makes vnet-bicep with snet-web and snet-app, both using nsg-bicep.
